response.overview: Super Bowl XXI, played on January 25, 1987, at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, California, saw the New York Giants defeat the Denver Broncos 39-20, capturing their first-ever Super Bowl title. The Giants’ victory was a combination of stellar defense, efficient offense, and a strong performance from their quarterback, Phil Simms, who delivered one of the most memorable games of his career.
response.tagline: New York Giants vs. Denver Broncos
response.title: Super Bowl XXI
